translations.web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
translations.bsb: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
translations.kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
translations.asv: Thou hast commanded us thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.
